title: Address Bali — Junior Penthouse 404, Pererenan Oceanfront

detail:
THE LAST PENTHOUSE
Residence 404 is the only penthouse still available at Address Bali, the certified five-star boutique hotel residence on the oceanfront at Pantai Lima, Pererenan. It sits on the fourth and highest residential floor, sharing the level with the building's 360° oceanfront rooftop — infinity pool, sun deck, restaurant and bar, sauna and ice bath — so the best of the hotel is a few steps from your door.

THE RESIDENCE
A 66 m² one-bedroom master suite facing the ocean. The living and dining room opens to a sea-view balcony; the bedroom and open-plan bathroom, with its freestanding stone tub, are designed as one generous space. Interiors are almost entirely hand-crafted — carved timber, textured wall finishes and custom furniture — with a high-end kitchen and a smart-home system. It is sold fully furnished and can join the hotel's rental programme, with unlimited owner stays.

THE BUILDING
Just 35 residences over four levels, every one with an ocean view. Pink (tourism) land zone, PBG obtained and construction in progress, with completion scheduled for Q2 2028. Owners have full five-star hotel services, a 24/7 concierge, a wellness and fitness suite, a Japanese garden and the private members' club, with a projected 12–14% ROI under in-house hotel management.

PRICE & TENURE
$275,000 on a 27-year leasehold. A further 10 years of lease can be added for $27,500. Secure it with a refundable $2,000 deposit, with the balance staged through construction to delivery. The fourth-floor plan and a 3D layout of the suite are in the gallery.

KEY FACTS

1 bedroom · 1 bathroom · 66 m² · sea-view balcony
Same floor as the 360° oceanfront rooftop pool, restaurant & bar
Certified five-star hotel residence · fully furnished

Completion: Q2 2028
Price: $275,000
